article.story: AMHERST, Mass. -- — Isaiah Swope made a go-ahead 3-pointer with nine seconds remaining and scored 20 points as Saint Louis knocked off UMass 73-71 on Tuesday night. Swope shot 8 for 18, including 4 for 13 from beyond the arc for the Billikens (14-9, 7-3 Atlantic 10 Conference). Gibson Jimerson scored 18 points and added five rebounds. Kobe Johnson shot 4 for 7, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. The Minutemen (10-13, 5-5) were led by Jaylen Curry, who posted 16 points and two steals. UMass also got 14 points and 14 rebounds from Daniel Rivera. Daniel Hankins-Sanford also had 14 points and seven rebounds. Saint Louis went into halftime leading UMass 35-33. Swope scored 10 second-half points. Up next for Saint Louis is a Friday matchup with Saint Joseph's on the road, and UMass visits La Salle on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
